author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
This is a good word sort lesson plan for #edu407 and will earn the badge but one thing to note you are doing a lesson on the short a and the long a using at -at and -ay rimes respectively. I think the ou diphtong was a typo given that there are no ou words in the word sort.

The key goal is to have students understand the role of how the phonics rule governs spelling.
